description: Fails on master: one POI of PT tagged with the Thai name of Caltex gives PT that alternative name, so the query shows the row of PT and lists its stations. The extract thailand_brand_translations is cut out of Thailand_asia_2.obf: the POIs nearest to Bangkok of each brand and up to 5 POIs per alternative name that produce it (the name of the POI equals the brand and one of its name:xx is that alternative).
